skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply fundamental concepts of linear algebra, including systems of linear equations, matrices, determinants, vector spaces, and linear mappings.
Develop logical reasoning and problem-solving skills in mathematical contexts.
Solve problems using linear algebra techniques and apply them to real-world scenarios, particularly in economics and business.
Enhance self-study and research capabilities, fostering independent and collaborative work habits.
Analyze and interpret mathematical models and their applications in economics and business.
